fusions.name: Ley Thread
fusions.desc: Flicks a thread of raw arcana that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spellsnare Weft
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile line of arcane strands ahead of you for 5 seconds. It deals 9 damage to each enemy that crosses it and stuns it for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Drain the Ley
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Siphoned Spark
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you drain 5 mana. Once every 6 seconds.
